meta.note: All prices are ESTIMATES. Children prices apply to ages 3-13 in most cases. Family prices show 2 adults + 2 children. Always check official websites for current pricing and pre-book online to save.

attractions.name: Noosa National Park Coastal Walk
attractions.description: One of Australia's most beautiful coastal walks — 10km return with boardwalk clifftop sections, rainforest tracks, hidden beaches (Tea Tree Bay, Granite Bay), and koala spotting in the eucalypt forests. Free and unforgettable.
attractions.note: FREE. Start from the end of Hastings Street. Walk a shorter section to Tea Tree Bay (1.2km return) with younger kids. Dolphins and turtles often spotted.

attractions.name: Noosa Main Beach
attractions.description: One of Queensland's most iconic beaches — gentle waves perfect for families, patrolled by lifeguards year-round, stunning national park backdrop, and Hastings Street just behind. The quintessential Noosa experience.
attractions.note: FREE. Parking is paid and scarce — arrive early or use the shuttle from Tewantin. Swim between the flags. Gentle waves perfect for young children.

attractions.name: Noosa Everglades Eco Cruise
attractions.description: Guided cruise through the Noosa Everglades — one of only two everglades systems on Earth. Mirror-still waters, incredible reflections, abundant birdlife, ancient tea tree forests. Half-day tours with commentary and refreshments.
attractions.note: Half-day cruise includes tea/coffee and cake. Full-day kayak + cruise combo available. Book ahead in peak. About 30 min drive from Noosa Heads.

attractions.name: Sunshine Beach
attractions.description: Stunning surf beach just south of Noosa Heads — golden sand, great surf, patrolled swimming area, surf club at the end of the beach. Quieter than Main Beach but equally beautiful. Walk the coastal track to Noosa Heads.
attractions.note: FREE. Free parking at Sunshine Beach surf club. Walk the coastal track to Noosa National Park (4km one-way). Great for surf families.

attractions.name: Noosa River & Canal Cruise
attractions.description: Scenic river cruise along the Noosa River and millionaire canal estates — see waterfront mansions, spot birdlife, learn about the river's ecology. Calm waters, relaxing commentary, refreshments on board.
attractions.note: Departs from Noosaville jetty. Family pass available. Combine with a Noosaville waterfront lunch. Sunset cruises also available.

attractions.name: Hastings Street Shopping & Dining
attractions.description: Queensland's most glamorous beachfront strip — boutique shopping, surf stores, gelato, cafes, and waterfront dining. Window shopping, people watching, and that unmistakable Noosa vibe. Free to wander.
attractions.note: FREE to walk. Window shopping and people watching. Gelato from Massimo's (~$6). Parking is paid — use the free shuttle or walk from Noosa Junction.

attractions.name: Noosa Farmers Market
attractions.description: Vibrant Sunday morning market — 150+ stalls of local produce, artisan food, fresh coffee, baked goods, plants, crafts. Live music, food stalls, dog-friendly. The best Sunday morning on the coast.
attractions.note: FREE entry. Sundays 7am-12pm at Noosa AFL Grounds. Budget ~$10-25pp for food/snacks. Fresh local produce. Arrive early for parking.

attractions.name: Alexandria Bay (A-Bay)
attractions.description: A pristine, unpatrolled beach accessible via the Noosa National Park coastal track — stunning views, natural beauty, and a sense of wilderness. Popular with surfers and nature lovers. Noosa's hidden gem.
attractions.note: FREE. Accessible via national park coastal track (3.8km from Noosa Heads). Unpatrolled — swim at own risk. Pack water and snacks. Beautiful and secluded.

attractions.name: Noosa Botanic Gardens
attractions.description: Beautiful botanic gardens by Lake MacDonald — amphitheatre, fern house, native gardens, lakeside walks, playground, picnic areas. Free and peaceful. A lovely morning outing away from the beach.
attractions.note: FREE. About 15 min drive from Noosa Heads. Amphitheatre hosts free concerts. Federation Pavilion is a photogenic spot. Bring a picnic.

attractions.name: Noosa Whale Watching (Jun-Nov)
attractions.description: Seasonal humpback whale watching tours departing Noosa — see whales breach, tail-slap and spy-hop during migration. Small vessel means intimate experience. Educational commentary onboard.
attractions.note: SEASONAL: June-November only. Book ahead in peak season. Motion sickness tablets recommended. Guarantee offered by some operators.

attractions.name: Teewah Beach & Coloured Sands Drive
attractions.description: 4WD adventure along a 70km beach highway — stunning coloured sand cliffs, fishing spots, camping areas, pristine beach dunes. Access the Cooloola section of the Great Sandy National Park. Unforgettable family adventure.
attractions.note: FREE park entry. 4WD essential — beach access requires permit. Check tide tables. Coloured Sands are stunning at sunrise. About 15 min drive from Noosa to the access point.

attractions.name: Noosa Spit Recreation Reserve
attractions.description: Calm river estuary at the northern end of Noosa — perfect for young children, paddleboarding, kayaking, fishing, and picnicking. Shallow water, sandy beach, and views across the river to Noosa North Shore. A local family favourite.
attractions.note: FREE. Free parking. Calm water perfect for toddlers. Kayak and SUP hire nearby. Bring a picnic or grab fish and chips from the Spit.
